mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost of an AI Technical Audit?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of an AI Technical Audit is not fixed and depends on several factors, including the number and complexity of AI models, the volume and variety of data sources, the scope of the audit (e.g., performance, security, ethics), and the depth of analysis required. We typically provide a custom quote after an initial consultation to understand your specific needs and current AI landscape. This ensures the audit is tailored to your requirements and budget.
